title: The Safety Gap in Large Speech Models: Hidden Within Audio Signals
excerpt: Even after recognizing acoustic cues, speech models may still fail to provide appropriate responses that ensure safety, privacy, and fairness. This paper explains the findings of VoxPrivacy and VoxSafeBench, focusing on independent evaluations conducted through real-world usage scenarios to facilitate continuous improvement, as well as the application companies that control personal assistants and in-vehicle assistant systems.
body:
**My judgment is that whether voice personal assistants can take on more important tasks depends on their ability to convert the speaker’s words and acoustic cues into accurate responses that ensure safety, privacy, and fairness.** The two papers I contributed to, VoxPrivacy and VoxSafeBench, reveal the gap between these two capabilities, and model developers need to conduct more targeted training. In light of this issue, I am more interested in two types of business opportunities: one is independent evaluations that incorporate real-world usage scenarios and continuously increase the difficulty of testing, and the other is companies that can seize opportunities in applications such as Personal Agents and in-vehicle assistants, and use feedback from failures and corrections to improve their products. Static rankings and simply integrating voice models are not sufficient to create a sustainable advantage.

## After identifying the voice, one also needs to know how to respond

When an adult asks how to use a kitchen knife, the assistant can provide appropriate instructions; if a child asks the same question, more careful safety reminders are needed, and it is advisable to have an adult assist when necessary. This example shows that the same text may require different responses depending on the speaker’s voice.

Privacy scenarios introduce an additional layer of complexity. If I tell a personal assistant a secret and ask them to keep it confidential, and another person asks about it later, the assistant should adhere to the original boundaries set for sharing that information. Even if the voice of the person asking is similar to mine, they still shouldn’t be given access to the secret. The model must understand who owns the information, who is asking at the moment, and whom the original user has authorized to receive that information.

Fairness, that is, equity, requires the model to make a different choice. When two candidates have identical qualifications, accent or vocal gender differences that are unrelated to the position should not affect their evaluation. Clues in the voice sometimes need to influence the response, while at other times they should be excluded from the judgment.

The two papers focus precisely on this connection. Some models are already capable of identifying certain acoustic cues, but they cannot consistently use them to generate appropriate responses. It is still necessary to distinguish between sound perception, speaker identification, and true identity verification. Each of these methods has its limitations; just because something sounds like a particular person does not replace the authentication and authorization required for sensitive operations.

## How to Measure the Gap in Two Papers

VoxPrivacy divides the confidentiality issues in shared voice devices into three levels. The first level involves following the explicit instruction to “tell no one”; the second level requires deciding whether to disclose information based on the speaker; ==blue|the third level further demands that the model proactively identify sensitive information and protect it in the absence of an explicit confidentiality command.\[1\]==

The latter two layers rely simultaneously on speaker relationships and disclosure rules. Taking the second-layer English task as an example, the accuracy of the original Kimi-Audio was around 50%, while the paper’s authors achieved 83.93% after making task-specific fine-tuning. ==blue|This indicates that relevant capabilities can be trained, but general speech capabilities do not automatically translate into reliable confidentiality behaviors.\[1\]==

Improvements still have limits. The overall accuracy of the fine-tuned model on third-layer Chinese tasks is 82.88%, while the success rate in protecting instances that should remain confidential is only 62.10%. The model’s performance further declines when another speaker with a similar voice is used to request the secret information. ==blue|A single composite score cannot fully reflect the risk of leakage; identity confusion and failed confidentiality protection need to be examined separately.\[1\]==

VoxSafeBench compares perception and response more directly. In the child voice task, researchers used direct recognition questions for similar audio clips, and Qwen3-Omni achieved an accuracy rate of 90% in determining whether the voice was that of a child or an adult; ==blue|Returning to the original task, the proportion of cases where safety awareness was demonstrated through warnings or rejections was only 0.5%. This metric is called the Safety Awareness Rate, and it is not equivalent to the accuracy rate of all safety-related actions.\[2\]==

Asking directly “Is it a child’s voice?” is simpler than deciding how to respond in an open dialogue, so this set of results does not prove that the model correctly identified a child’s voice every time a response failed. It still reveals significant gaps: the model can recognize a clue when asked directly, but rarely uses it appropriately in actual responses. ==blue|Other models also suffer from weak perception capabilities, and subsequent training needs to take both types of failures into account.\[2\]==

## Personal Agents and in-vehicle assistants require targeted post-training

Once a personal assistant starts remembering users’ preferences and historical information, confidentiality becomes a continuous and important requirement. For example, in a personal car, the driver, passengers, and children may take turns asking questions, and background noises can also affect whether the responses are suitable to be spoken aloud. A single instance of accidental disclosure or inappropriate instructions for dangerous actions can influence whether users are willing to entrust it with more important tasks.

I believe that safety, privacy, and fairness need to be incorporated into the post-training phase of voice models as well as product validation. While ordinary voice data can improve recognition and dialogue capabilities, specialized test scenarios are still required to establish connections between sound conditions, user relationships, and desired behaviors. For example, different strategies should be trained for dangerous operation requests made in adult or child voices; in evaluation tasks involving individuals with similar qualifications but different accents, any unreasonable disparities must be checked.

^[Currently, large speech models still lack large-scale scaling data compared to text.]

Model manufacturers also need to ensure the usability of normal tasks. Refusing all privacy requests will prevent original users from accessing their own information, while ignoring differences between speakers may lead to information being leaked to others. The fine-tuning experiments with VoxPrivacy provide evidence of its trainability, but actual products still need to be tested for performance in multi-user scenarios, with noise, and during prolonged interactions.

## Two industry opportunities I’m interested in

**The first category is third-party independent evaluations that are continuously iterated based on real User Cases.** Model manufacturers need to identify gaps in training, while vehicle assistants and personal assistant manufacturers need to determine whether their products meet their promised capabilities before integrating or upgrading models. The needs of these two types of customers create room for independent verification.

Valuable evaluation tasks should gradually increase in difficulty, progressing from single-round requests to scenarios involving multi-round confidentiality, similar vocal tones, multiple interruptions, and complex background noises. Metrics such as clue recognition, accurate disclosure, and inappropriate refusals should be measured accordingly. Each time a customer switches models or adjusts product rules, these tests can be reused to determine whether previously resolved issues have reappeared.

Whether this approach can become an independent business depends on whether testing and updates can keep up with the problems that arise in real-world scenarios, as well as whether customers include it in their ongoing validation processes. Public static lists can easily be replaced by internal testing conducted by manufacturers; merely having shortcomings in the model today is not sufficient to prove that a third party can charge fees over the long term.

**The second category includes companies that control the application entry points and are able to establish feedback loops using scenario data.** Car assistants like Xiaomi Auto and Huawei Auto, as well as other Personal Agent products, have close access to user information, device status, and actual tasks, which gives them the opportunity to identify failures that might be overlooked by conventional benchmarks. This represents a potential advantage, but current evidence does not show that these companies have yet established effective data feedback loops.

^[The so-called data flywheel requires going through an actual process. When a mistake is found in a product, necessary information is retained within the allowed scope; after review, the appropriate action is determined, resulting in new evaluation or training samples. Then, it is checked whether the updated model has improved. Only when failures decrease and normal tasks can still be completed can feedback truly drive the next round of product usage.]

Users' secrets, passenger voices, and bystander information should not be assumed to be suitable as training data. Informed consent, restrictions on usage, and proper data anonymization need to be designed alongside data collection and verification processes. Having the necessary equipment and user base merely creates the conditions for interaction; it is only through high-quality feedback and the ability to continuously improve that a competitive advantage can be achieved.

Model manufacturers will continue to develop these capabilities. Therefore, I will focus on two verifiable aspects: whether they can consistently identify new issues in actual products, and whether the companies using these models can turn those issues into reusable tests to reduce similar failures. After identifying who is speaking, the assistant still needs to adhere to the boundaries of what to say and to whom, so that users have reason to entrust it with more personal and important tasks.

## Key Sources

1. [VoxPrivacy v2](https://arxiv.org/html/2601.19956v2), task hierarchy, Table 3, similar voice attack, and definition of metrics.
1. [VoxSafeBench v2](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.14548v2), safety and fairness tasks, comparison of perceptions and responses in Appendix J and Table 42.

*The revision of this article and verification of its sources were completed as of 2026-10-09.*

bcb90b4500840b629566e8473107ddde5779fbb7.translation: **The first category is third-party independent evaluations that are continuously iterated based on real User Cases.** Model manufacturers need to identify gaps in training, while vehicle assistants and personal assistant manufacturers need to determine whether their products meet their promised capabilities before integrating or upgrading models. The needs of these two types of customers create room for independent verification.

b11fc5861463abd2d3fa2d1f07fa3deaedd95227.source: 有价值的评测应持续增加难度，从单轮请求推进到跨轮次保密、相似音色、多人打断和复杂背景声，并分别测量线索识别、正确披露与不合理拒答。客户每次更换模型或调整产品规则，都应能复用这些测试，发现原本已经解决的问题是否再次出现。
b11fc5861463abd2d3fa2d1f07fa3deaedd95227.context: 我关注的两个产业机会
b11fc5861463abd2d3fa2d1f07fa3deaedd95227.translation: Valuable evaluation tasks should gradually increase in difficulty, progressing from single-round requests to scenarios involving multi-round confidentiality, similar vocal tones, multiple interruptions, and complex background noises. Metrics such as clue recognition, accurate disclosure, and inappropriate refusals should be measured accordingly. Each time a customer switches models or adjusts product rules, these tests can be reused to determine whether previously resolved issues have reappeared.

2a818310f3e68201ff5bee402b5b666c29bab8d2.source: 这一层能否成为独立生意，取决于测试更新迭代能否跟上真实场景暴露的问题，以及客户是否把它纳入持续验收。公开静态榜单容易被厂商内部测试替代；单凭模型今天有缺口，也不足以证明第三方能长期收费。
2a818310f3e68201ff5bee402b5b666c29bab8d2.context: 我关注的两个产业机会
2a818310f3e68201ff5bee402b5b666c29bab8d2.translation: Whether this approach can become an independent business depends on whether testing and updates can keep up with the problems that arise in real-world scenarios, as well as whether customers include it in their ongoing validation processes. Public static lists can easily be replaced by internal testing conducted by manufacturers; merely having shortcomings in the model today is not sufficient to prove that a third party can charge fees over the long term.

0e6b19176d3562e5320397305dfee06df3c0024a.source: **第二类是掌握应用入口、能够建立场景数据反馈的公司。** 小米汽车、华为汽车这类车载助手入口，以及其他 Personal Agent 产品方，接近用户关系、设备状态和实际任务，有机会发现通用基准遗漏的失败。这是潜在优势，但是现有材料尚不能证明这些公司已经建成有效的数据飞轮。
0e6b19176d3562e5320397305dfee06df3c0024a.context: 我关注的两个产业机会
0e6b19176d3562e5320397305dfee06df3c0024a.translation: **The second category includes companies that control the application entry points and are able to establish feedback loops using scenario data.** Car assistants like Xiaomi Auto and Huawei Auto, as well as other Personal Agent products, have close access to user information, device status, and actual tasks, which gives them the opportunity to identify failures that might be overlooked by conventional benchmarks. This represents a potential advantage, but current evidence does not show that these companies have yet established effective data feedback loops.

10abc3f75ed8cc81a4d691b26f0a7f6dcfb7e85e.source: ^[所谓数据飞轮，需要走完实际过程。产品发现一次错误，在授权范围内保留必要信息，经复核确定合适行为，形成新的评测或训练样本，再检查更新后的模型有没有改善。失败减少、正常任务也能完成，反馈才真正推动下一轮产品使用。]
10abc3f75ed8cc81a4d691b26f0a7f6dcfb7e85e.context: 我关注的两个产业机会
10abc3f75ed8cc81a4d691b26f0a7f6dcfb7e85e.translation: ^[The so-called data flywheel requires going through an actual process. When a mistake is found in a product, necessary information is retained within the allowed scope; after review, the appropriate action is determined, resulting in new evaluation or training samples. Then, it is checked whether the updated model has improved. Only when failures decrease and normal tasks can still be completed can feedback truly drive the next round of product usage.]

52a35fce19aeea558a43a88974049b2f68322456.source: 用户的秘密、乘客声音和旁观者信息不能默认成为训练资源。知情同意、用途限制与必要的脱敏，需要与采集和验证一起设计。拥有设备和用户量，只提供了接触场景的条件，正确的反馈质量与持续迭代能力才可能形成差异。
52a35fce19aeea558a43a88974049b2f68322456.context: 我关注的两个产业机会
52a35fce19aeea558a43a88974049b2f68322456.translation: Users' secrets, passenger voices, and bystander information should not be assumed to be suitable as training data. Informed consent, restrictions on usage, and proper data anonymization need to be designed alongside data collection and verification processes. Having the necessary equipment and user base merely creates the conditions for interaction; it is only through high-quality feedback and the ability to continuously improve that a competitive advantage can be achieved.

ad50443240ea4e0d1409dc9a09c71ce7444a7962.source: 模型厂商会继续补齐这些能力。因此，我会把关注点放在两件可验证的事情上，独立评测能否持续发现实际产品中的新问题，应用公司能否把这些问题转成可复用的测试并减少同类失败。助手辨认出是谁在说话以后，仍需守住该说什么、对谁说的边界，用户才有理由把更私人、更重要的任务交给它。
ad50443240ea4e0d1409dc9a09c71ce7444a7962.context: 我关注的两个产业机会
ad50443240ea4e0d1409dc9a09c71ce7444a7962.translation: Model manufacturers will continue to develop these capabilities. Therefore, I will focus on two verifiable aspects: whether they can consistently identify new issues in actual products, and whether the companies using these models can turn those issues into reusable tests to reduce similar failures. After identifying who is speaking, the assistant still needs to adhere to the boundaries of what to say and to whom, so that users have reason to entrust it with more personal and important tasks.
